After 21 years at Oracle, including a decade working with one of our largest customers, I noticed a frustrating pattern. Cloud certifications were everywhere. AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, there seemed to be a new badge every other month. But when those same developers were asked to design or deploy real infrastructure, things often fell apart. What is Docker
Docker is an open source platform that enables developers and engineers to build, deploy, run and manage containers. Containers are standardized, executable components that combine application source code, together with the operating System libraries and dependencies required to run that code in any environment. containers enable multiple application components to share the resources of a single instance of the host Operating System.
